import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Load attendance data
attendance_df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_145/context/csv/attendance.csv')

# Connect to event database
conn = sqlite3.connect('/input/task_145/context/db/event.db')
event_df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT event_id, type FROM event", conn)
conn.close()

# Count members per event
attendance_counts = attendance_df.groupby('link_to_event').size().reset_index(name='member_count')

# Filter events with more than 10 members
high_attendance_events = attendance_counts[attendance_counts['member_count'] > 10]

# Join with event table to get event types
merged = high_attendance_events.merge(event_df, left_on='link_to_event', right_on='event_id', how='inner')

# Filter for meetings only
meetings = merged[merged['type'] == 'Meeting']

# Count the number of meetings
meeting_count = len(meetings)

print(f"Events with >10 attendees: {len(high_attendance_events)}")
print(f"Meetings among those: {meeting_count}")
